大家好，我想分享一个我一直使用的工作流程，该工作流程通过 Flux-Kontext LoRA 训练获得了极其精确的结果。对于任何努力准备数据集的人来说，这种方法将改变游戏规则。

核心理念：逆向工作并自动化一切

Flux-Kontext 的标准方法是找到“之前”图像，然后以某种方式创建“之后”图像（例如，添加对象、脱掉衣服）。这通常是最难的部分，尤其是当人工智能在生成您想要的特定更改时不一致时。然后你必须手动编写所有 sidecar 文本文件。

我的方法是逆转该过程并使整个管道自动化。

分步工作流程

假设您想要训练 LoRA 摘掉特定类型的帽子。

  1. 创建您的“After”文件夹（数据集）：首先，收集或创建一组主题所在的图像穿着你想要瞄准的帽子。这是你的起点，也将成为你的起点数据集文件夹。

  2. 生成您的“之前”文件夹（控制集）和提示：现在，从数据集文件夹中获取所有图像，并通过 Flux-Kontext 批处理过程运行它们。您的目标是撤消的改变。你会提示它“摘掉帽子”、“给这个人一个干净的发型”等等。出现的干净、不戴帽子的图像就是你的。控制图像。最好的部分？工作流程会自动为每个图像对创建必要的 sidecar 文本文件。

  3. “清洁”的好处：这种方法的一个巨大优点是，您正在训练模型从可能有缺陷的“之后”图像到完美的“之前”图像。这通常会教会 LoRA 消除 AI 伪影和缺陷，从而产生更清晰的最终输出。

  4. 最终确定并训练：您现在拥有一组完美配对的控制和数据集图像，以及为您编写的所有 sidecar 文本文件。只需添加一些示例图像，您就可以开始训练了。由此产生的 LoRA 将高度专业化地执行一项特定任务。

使这个工作流程更容易

管理控制图像、数据集图像及其相应的文本文件可能是一件令人头疼的事情。你必须不断地来回点击以确保图片_a.jpg与 匹配图像_b.jpg和提示_a.txt.

为了解决这个问题，我开发了一个自定义桌面应用程序，让您可以在一个窗口中同时查看这三个内容。这可以节省大量时间，并且完全消除了不匹配文件破坏训练运行的风险。

如果您有兴趣简化此工作流程，我的支持者可以使用此工具和我的更深入的教程帕特隆。您可以在以下位置查看：Patreon.com/LoboForgeAI.
这是视频演示：https://vimeo.com/manage/videos/1134804036?fl=pl&fe=vl

另外，如果您想要“Takeitoff”LoRA 脱掉衣服，我的 patreon 上也有提供。

尝试一下这个工作流程，让我知道您用它构建了什么样的创意 LoRA

o.en:
Hey everyone, I wanted to share a workflow I've been using to get incredibly precise results with Flux-Kontext LoRA training. This method is a game-changer for anyone struggling with dataset preparation.

The Core Idea: Work Backwards and Automate Everything

The standard approach to Flux-Kontext is to find a "before" image and then somehow create the "after" image (e.g., add an object, remove clothing). This is often the hardest part, especially if the AI is inconsistent in generating the specific change you want. Then you have to manually write all the sidecar text files.

My method is toreverse the processand automate the entire pipeline.

The Step-by-Step Workflow

Let's say you want to train a LoRA to remove a specific type of hat.

  1. Create Your "After" Folder (The Dataset):First, gather or create a set of images where the subject iswearingthe hat you want to target. This is your starting point and will become yourDatasetfolder.

  2. Generate Your "Before" Folder (The Control Set) AND the Prompts:Now, take all the images from your Dataset folder and run them through a Flux-Kontext batch process. Your goal here is toundothe change. You would prompt it to "remove the hat," "give the person a clean hairstyle," etc. The clean, hatless images that come out are yourControlimages.The best part? The workflow automatically creates the necessary sidecar text file for every image pair as it goes.

  3. The Benefit of "Cleaning":A huge advantage of this method is that you're training the model to go from a potentially flawed "after" image to a perfect "before" image. This often teaches the LoRA to remove AI artifacts and imperfections, resulting in a much cleaner final output.

  4. Finalize and Train:You now have a perfectly paired set of Control and Dataset images, with all the sidecar text files written for you. Just add a few sample images, and you're ready to start training. The resulting LoRA will be highly specialized in performing that one specific task.

Making This Workflow Easier

Managing the Control images, Dataset images, and their corresponding text files can be a headache. You have to constantly click back and forth to make sureimage_a.jpgmatches withimage_b.jpgandprompt_a.txt.

To solve this, I developed a custom desktop application that lets you see all three at once in a single window. It’s a huge time-saver and completely removes the risk of mismatched files ruining a training run.

If you're interested in streamlining this workflow, this tool and my more in-depth tutorials are available for my supporters onPatreon. You can check it out atPatreon.com/LoboForgeAI.
Here is the video demo: https://vimeo.com/manage/videos/1134804036?fl=pl&fe=vl

Also, if you would like the "Takeitoff" LoRA to remove clothing its also available on my patreon.

Give this workflow a try and let me know what kind of creative LoRAs you build with it
